d:
A viral CCTV video from Seoni, Madhya Pradesh, has triggered serious allegations against police officers. Additional SP Deepak Mishra is allegedly heard suggesting that ganja be placed in a young man's bag while questioning an adult couple at a hotel. The hotel owner has also accused police officers of demanding monthly bribes. The ASP has called the video AI-generated. An investigation is underway.
